description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters that belong to your account, such as the cluster ID.

description.zh:
连接地址ID。

> 您可以通过接口[DescribeDBClusterEndpoints](~~98205~~)查询DBEndpointId。
description.en:
The ID of the endpoint.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusterEndpoints](~~98205~~) operation to query the endpoints of a specified PolarDB cluster.

description.zh:
<props="intl">连接地址的网络类型，仅支持**Public**（公网）类型。</props>
<props="china">连接地址的网络类型，取值范围如下：</props>
<props="china">- **Public**：公网。</props>
<props="china">- **Inner**：经典网络。</props>
description.en: The network type of the endpoint. Set the value to **Public** (public network).

descriptions.zh:
> * 支持删除PolarDB集群主地址、默认集群地址和自定义集群地址的公网或经典网络连接地址。 
> * 仅中国站支持经典网络连接地址，国际站暂不支持，因此国际站无需删除经典网络连接地址。
descriptions.en:
> - You can delete a public-facing or classic network endpoint of the primary endpoint, the default cluster endpoint, or a custom cluster endpoint.
>
> - Classic network endpoints are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Therefore, you do not need to delete classic network endpoints on the International site (alibabacloud.com).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-db-endpoint-address --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --db-endpoint-id pe-000000000000000 --net-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
